div.div:
P0 Foundation: identity and security
Who acts as whom. GitHub swaps its OIDC (OpenID Connect) token for a short-lived login through WIF (Workload Identity Federation). The laptop impersonates the same service accounts with a short-lived token. GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine) nodes run as their own service account.
